items.quote: Wenvi Osford took ownership of engagement with industry stakeholders and steered it to completion.
He handled bilateral negotiations on the water agreement competently within his team.
He championed policy options for the cabinet paper on ageing and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Wenvi handled the shift to a new way of working after two branches were combined competently within his team.
Wenvi set the direction for the division's budget planning across the public service.
He managed teamwork across departments on the annual review for his unit.
He set the direction for the five-year strategic plan for the division across the public service.
